title: Granular SLO-driven failover rehearsals with prioritized tenant shedding and backup fidelity attestations
creator: Asha Patel
description: Build an automated rehearsal framework and verification suite for active-passive DR that is driven by SLO budgets and supports tenant-prioritized load shedding, circuit-breaker calibration, progressive cutover, and strong backup/restore fidelity attestations. This ticket scopes the end-to-end orchestration (orchestrator), verification checks (data integrity and functional smoke), and observability hooks (dashboards, traces, and audit entries) required to run scheduled failover drills with low blast radius and deterministic rollback gates.
acceptance_criteria: Rehearsal Orchestrator can run a scheduled active->passive cutover in a sandbox region and full-run logs are persisted in the DR audit index
Prioritized tenant shedding policy applied: high-priority tenants maintain read traffic while P3 tenants are shed per policy during rehearsals
Circuit-breaker thresholds exposed as runtime knobs and automatically toggled by the orchestrator based on latency and error budgets
Backup/restore verification validates KV/TokenStore snapshots by checksum and sample-query pass rates >= 99% for critical tables
Automated SLO smoke tests run pre-cutover, during cutover, and post-cutover and emit pass/fail to the dashboard and to the rollout controller
Rollback gate triggers when any critical smoke test fails or when state-consistency checks regress beyond defined thresholds
End-to-end runbook produced (Confluence) with exact commands, stakeholder contact list, escalation steps, and estimated blast-radius metrics
Two rehearsals executed in non-prod with learnings captured; one rehearsal with staged canary routing and one with full traffic siphon simulated
steps: Design: finalize SLO-driven decision matrix (latency/error budgets => shed/reroute/fallback) and tenant priority schema
Spike: run a restore validation spike in staging to validate snapshot checksum approach and sample query set
Orchestrator: implement a controller that sequences (pre-checks -> freeze writes -> snapshot validation -> reroute -> post-checks -> release) with RBAC and audit entries
Circuit breakers: implement dynamic CB toggles (concurrency, latency, error-rate) and expose endpoints for the orchestrator to flip them
Load shedding: add prioritized shedding policy engine that can apply rate-limits or drop rules per-tenant during rehearsals
Verification suite: build sample-query runner, checksum comparator, tokenstore digest validator, and KV read-after-write sanity tests
Observability: wire rehearsal runs into console dashboards with per-step timing, SLO graphs, and a diff of pre/post snapshot checksums
Runbook & scheduling: author Confluence runbook and add rehearsal cron to onboarding calendar; include stakeholder notifications and automated PagerDuty test signals
Dry runs: perform two dry-run rehearsals in sandbox with blue/green and canary routing and capture telemetry
Postmortem & tuning: collect metrics, run incident blameless postmortem, and iterate on gating thresholds and tenant prioritization
notes: We need the tokenstore snapshot API hardened before the full rehearsal. The checksum approach chosen is SHA256 over canonicalized KV exports; this was validated in the spike but needs performance tuning for large snapshots.
comments: 2026-02-18 - Asha Patel: Initial scope and goals created. Spike planned to validate checksum approach and sample query selection.

2026-02-25 - Miguel Torres: Completed restore spike in staging. Found two corner cases: tombstoned keys serialized differently across versions and a 0.8% mismatch on legacy tokens. Proposal: canonicalize snapshots and add a reconciliation step for legacy token formats.
2026-03-02 - Design Review (Lina Ho): Approved SLO decision matrix but requested clearer tenant priority labels (P0,P1,P2,P3 mapping) and a UI mock for manual override in Console.
2026-03-05 - Infra (Jamal Reed): Blocker - sandbox region quota insufficient for parallel canary. Requested quota bump from CloudOps; mitigation plan: serialize dry runs until quota available.
2026-03-09 - Miguel Torres: Orchestrator prototype merged (PR #142). Controller supports pre-checks, freeze-writes, and stepwise rollback. Integration tests added for simple KV restore verification.

2026-03-12 - QA (Priya Singh): Smoke test harness ran two dry rehearsals. One failure observed: circuit-breaker flip timing caused transient 502s for P1 tenants; tuning needed to delay shedding until KV warmup finishes.

2026-03-14 - Post-DR meeting notes: Agreed to add a 30s KV-warmup hold before activating tenant shed policies and to extend checksum verification timeout for large snapshots. Next milestone: non-prod full-route rehearsal scheduled 2026-03-24.
